```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)
library(boot)
library(glasso)
library(igraph)
library(gtsummary)
library(patchwork)

set.seed(2025)
```

```{r}
data_dir <- "/Users/java/Desktop/fMRI_CMU_restingState/data"
files <- list.files(data_dir, full.names = TRUE)

read_subject <- function(file) {
  dat <- as.matrix(read.table(file))
  scale(dat)
}
```


```{r}
## ---- graphical lasso precision ----
fit_glasso_precision <- function(dat, lambda) {
  S <- cov(dat)
  glasso(S, rho = lambda)$wi
}

## ---- GGM from precision ----
graph_from_precision <- function(Theta) {
  adj <- abs(Theta) > 0
  diag(adj) <- 0
  graph_from_adjacency_matrix(adj, mode = "undirected", diag = FALSE)
}

## ---- partial correlation graph ----
graph_from_partial_corr <- function(Theta, thresh) {
  D <- diag(1 / sqrt(diag(Theta)))
  pcor <- -D %*% Theta %*% D
  diag(pcor) <- 0
  adj <- abs(pcor) > thresh
  graph_from_adjacency_matrix(adj, mode = "undirected", diag = FALSE)
}
```


```{r}
graph_metrics <- function(g) {
  tibble(
    density = edge_density(g),
    mean_distance = mean_distance(g, directed = FALSE),
    eccentricity = mean(eccentricity(g)),
    modularity = modularity(cluster_fast_greedy(g))
  )
}
```


```{r}
set.seed(2025)

tune_file <- sample(files, 1)
dat_tune <- read_subject(tune_file)

## ---- lambda tuning ----
lambda_grid <- exp(seq(log(0.01), log(0.3), length.out = 10))

lambda_results <- map_dfr(lambda_grid, function(lam) {
  Theta <- fit_glasso_precision(dat_tune, lam)
  g <- graph_from_precision(Theta)
  tibble(lambda = lam, edges = gsize(g))
})

lambda_selected <- lambda_results %>%
  arrange(lambda) %>%
  mutate(edge_drop = c(NA, diff(edges))) %>%
  filter(edge_drop < quantile(edge_drop, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  pull(lambda)
```


```{r}
ggplot(lambda_results, aes(lambda, edges)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  scale_x_log10() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = lambda_selected,
             linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(
    title = "Lambda selection via edge sparsity",
    x = expression(lambda),
    y = "Number of edges"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```


```{r}
pcor_grid <- seq(0.05, 0.3, by = 0.05)
Theta_tune <- fit_glasso_precision(dat_tune, lambda_selected)

pcor_results <- map_dfr(pcor_grid, function(th) {
  g <- graph_from_partial_corr(Theta_tune, th)
  tibble(pcor_thresh = th, edges = gsize(g))
})

target_edges <- lambda_results %>%
  filter(lambda == lambda_selected) %>%
  pull(edges)

pcor_selected <- pcor_results %>%
  mutate(diff = abs(edges - target_edges)) %>%
  arrange(diff) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  pull(pcor_thresh)
```


```{r}
ggplot(pcor_results, aes(pcor_thresh, edges)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = pcor_selected,
             linetype = "dashed", color = "blue") +
  labs(
    title = "Partial correlation threshold selection",
    x = "Threshold",
    y = "Number of edges"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```


```{r}
lambda <- lambda_selected
pcor_thresh <- pcor_selected

all_results <- map_dfr(files, function(f) {

  subject <- sprintf(
    "%07d",
    as.integer(stringr::str_extract(basename(f), "\\d+"))
  )

  dat <- read_subject(f)
  Theta <- fit_glasso_precision(dat, lambda)

  bind_rows(
    graph_metrics(graph_from_precision(Theta)) %>%
      mutate(subject = subject, method = "GGM"),
    graph_metrics(graph_from_partial_corr(Theta, pcor_thresh)) %>%
      mutate(subject = subject, method = "PartialCorr")
  )
})

stopifnot(all(table(all_results$subject) == 2))
```


```{r}
paired_df <- all_results %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = method,
    values_from = c(density, mean_distance, eccentricity, modularity)
  )

metrics <- c("density", "mean_distance", "eccentricity", "modularity")

diff_df <- map_dfr(metrics, function(m) {
  tibble(
    metric = m,
    diff =
      paired_df[[paste0(m, "_PartialCorr")]] -
      paired_df[[paste0(m, "_GGM")]]
  )
})
```


```{r}
t_results <- diff_df %>%
  group_by(metric) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_diff = mean(diff),
    sd_diff   = sd(diff),
    p_raw     = t.test(diff)$p.value,
    cohens_d  = mean(diff) / sd(diff),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj = p.adjust(p_raw, method = "BH")
  )

boot_ci <- diff_df %>%
  group_by(metric) %>%
  summarise(
    ci_low  = quantile(boot(diff, function(d, i) mean(d[i]), R = 2000)$t, 0.025),
    ci_high = quantile(boot(diff, function(d, i) mean(d[i]), R = 2000)$t, 0.975),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```


```{r}
final_table <- t_results %>%
  left_join(boot_ci, by = "metric") %>%
  mutate(
    `Mean Difference (SD)` = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f)", mean_diff, sd_diff),
    `95% CI` = sprintf("[%.3f, %.3f]", ci_low, ci_high),
    `Raw p-value` = sprintf("%.4f", p_raw),
    `BH-adjusted p-value` = sprintf("%.4f", p_adj),
    `Cohen's d` = round(cohens_d, 3)
  ) %>%
  select(
    Metric = metric,
    `Mean Difference (SD)`,
    `95% CI`,
    `Cohen's d`,
    `Raw p-value`,
    `BH-adjusted p-value`
  )

final_table
```


```{r}
p <- ggplot(diff_df, aes(metric, diff)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "grey90") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "Paired differences in graph-theoretic metrics",
    y = "PartialCorr − GGM",
    x = "Metric"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave(
  filename = "boxplot_paired_differences.pdf",
  plot = p,
  width = 6,
  height = 4,
  units = "in"
)
```

```{r}
## =====================================================
## Functional Connectivity Network Visualization
## Partial Correlation vs Gaussian Graphical Model
## =====================================================

## -------------------------------
## 0. Load required packages
## -------------------------------
library(glasso)
library(igraph)
library(Matrix)

## -------------------------------
## 1. Check and prepare data
## -------------------------------
# This script assumes you ALREADY loaded one subject's
# resting-state fMRI data as:
#   dat_mat  OR  dat_param
# with dimension: time x ROI

if (exists("dat_mat")) {
  X <- as.matrix(dat_mat)
} else if (exists("dat_param")) {
  X <- as.matrix(dat_param)
} else {
  stop("ERROR: dat_mat or dat_param not found in environment.")
}

# sanity checks
stopifnot(is.numeric(X))
stopifnot(!any(is.na(X)))

n <- nrow(X)
p <- ncol(X)

cat("Using data with", n, "time points and", p, "ROIs\n")

## -------------------------------
## 2. Sample covariance (stabilized)
## -------------------------------
S <- cov(X)

# add small ridge to ensure positive definiteness
eps <- 1e-4
S <- S + diag(eps, p)

## -------------------------------
## 3. Partial correlation network
## -------------------------------
Omega_hat <- solve(S)

pcor_mat <- -Omega_hat / sqrt(outer(diag(Omega_hat), diag(Omega_hat)))
diag(pcor_mat) <- 0

# threshold chosen from your tuning procedure
pcor_thresh <- 0.15   # <-- adjust if needed
adj_pcor <- abs(pcor_mat) > pcor_thresh

cat("Partial correlation edges:",
    sum(adj_pcor) / 2, "\n")

## -------------------------------
## 4. Gaussian Graphical Model (glasso)
## -------------------------------
lambda <- 0.10   # <-- use your selected lambda

glasso_fit <- glasso(S, rho = lambda)

Omega_glasso <- glasso_fit$wi
adj_glasso <- Omega_glasso != 0
diag(adj_glasso) <- 0

cat("GGM edges:",
    sum(adj_glasso) / 2, "\n")

## -------------------------------
## 5. Build igraph objects
## -------------------------------
g_pcor <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(
  adj_pcor,
  mode = "undirected",
  diag = FALSE
)

g_glasso <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(
  adj_glasso,
  mode = "undirected",
  diag = FALSE
)

## -------------------------------
## 6. Shared node layout (critical)
## -------------------------------
set.seed(2025)
layout_shared <- layout_with_fr(g_pcor)

## -------------------------------
## 7. Plot and export to PDF
## -------------------------------
pdf("network_visualization.pdf", width = 10, height = 5)

par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(1, 1, 3, 1))

plot(
  g_pcor,
  layout = layout_shared,
  vertex.size = 3,
  vertex.label = NA,
  edge.color = "grey60",
  main = "(a) Partial Correlation Network"
)

plot(
  g_glasso,
  layout = layout_shared,
  vertex.size = 3,
  vertex.label = NA,
  edge.color = "grey60",
  main = "(b) Gaussian Graphical Model"
)

dev.off()

cat("Saved figure: network_visualization.pdf\n")
```
